SCENE sc_001 0-69500 EXT. WOODLAND COTTAGE - DAY
EP07:E1 0-4800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the cold, damp ground outside the stone cottage, pulling weeds from the dirt with her bare hands.
EP07:E2 0-4800 ACTION: Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.
EP07:E3 4800-11800 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot as an ornate black-and-gold carriage with crest emblazoned on the door rolls to a stop on the muddy path outside the gate.
EP07:E4 5000-11500 SOUND: Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
EP07:E5 11800-15000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.
EP07:E6 15000-19500 CAMERA: Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
EP07:E7 19500-21000 ACTION: Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
EP07:E8 21000-24000 ACTION: Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.
EP07:E9 22000-24500 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Mocking, Condescending]: "This is where you live now?"
EP07:E10 24500-29800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.
EP07:E11 25000-29800 GERALD [Arrogant, Scornful]: "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."
EP07:E12 29800-32800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.
EP07:E13 30000-32600 JULIANA [Sharp, Unintimidated]: "You came all this way just to insult my home?"
EP07:E14 32800-37500 CAMERA: Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.
EP07:E15 33200-37800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Gloating, Mocking]: "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."
EP07:E16 37800-39800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.
EP07:E17 38200-39800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [O.S.) (Cruel]: "You look like a servant."
EP07:E18 39800-41000 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
EP07:E19 41000-45000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.
EP07:E20 41200-44800 JULIANA [Proud, Resolute]: "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."
EP07:E21 45000-47000 CAMERA: Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.
EP07:E22 45200-46800 GERALD [Biting, Condescending]: "You were born a lady."
EP07:E23 47000-50800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.
EP07:E24 48800-50400 JULIANA [Firm, Unapologetic]: "And I remain one."
EP07:E25 50800-54800 CAMERA: Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.
EP07:E26 51500-54600 GERALD [Bitter, Sneering]: "You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."
EP07:E27 54800-61500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.
EP07:E28 57800-61000 JULIANA [Passionate, Defiant]: "I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."
EP07:E29 61500-65200 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.
EP07:E30 61800-64800 JULIANA [Cold, Commanding]: "You have no authority here. Leave."
EP07:E31 65200-69500 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.
EP07:E32 65600-68500 GERALD [Furious, Threatening]: "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
EP07:E33 68600-69500 GERALD [Spiteful, Boastful]: "And your husband?"
SCENE sc_002 69500-75500 EXT. FOREST PATH - CONTINUOUS
EP07:E34 69500-74000 CAMERA: Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.
EP07:E35 69500-71200 GERALD [V.O.) (Snarl]: "Where is that beggar husband?"
EP07:E36 70000-75500 ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
EP07:E37 74000-75500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
SCENE sc_003 75500-116000 EXT. WOODLAND COTTAGE - CONTINUOUS
EP07:E38 75500-78500 CAMERA: Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
EP07:E39 76200-77500 SOUND: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
EP07:E40 78500-81000 CAMERA: Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
EP07:E41 81000-83500 CAMERA: Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
EP07:E42 81500-84000 ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
EP07:E43 83500-88000 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.
EP07:E44 86500-88500 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed]: "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
EP07:E45 88600-90000 GERALD [Trembling, Trying to Save Face]: "What are you staring at?"
EP07:E46 90000-91500 ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
EP07:E47 90100-91400 GERALD [Nervous, Hurried]: "We are leaving."
EP07:E48 91500-93800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.
EP07:E49 92000-93800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Outraged, Flustered]: "Leaving? Gerald!"
EP07:E50 93800-96500 ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
EP07:E51 95000-96000 SOUND: Carriage door slamming shut.
EP07:E52 96000-99000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.
EP07:E53 99000-103500 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of Juliana turning toward the Scarred Bearded Man, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration.
EP07:E54 100800-103200 JULIANA [Impressed, Softly Amused]: "You didn't say a word."
EP07:E55 103500-107500 CAMERA: Close-up on the Scarred Bearded Man looking down at her, his rugged features softening with quiet affection.
EP07:E56 106000-107800 SCARRED BEARDED MAN [Low, Gentle, Confident]: "I didn't need to."
EP07:E57 107500-111500 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.
EP07:E58 111500-116000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking after him, a radiant and grateful smile blooming across her face as the scene fades out.
